positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
High-Performance Linear Algebra API: Benchmarked, architected, implemented, and tested a policy-based design that leveraged static polymorphism to create a highly optimized mathematical matrix API built upon the Eigen linear algebra library.  Reduced run time of several high-profile function calls by more than 30%.

Resolved Deadlocking Issue in Database:  Resolved long-standing deadlocking issue in crucial database class with redesign.  Prioritized encapsulation, and instituted a fast and safe design built around exception handling and lock promotion.

CI/CD Capability:  Implemented feature in the Jenkins pipeline that automatically configures, builds, and runs a suite of system tests that were originally a standalone project.  Saving an average of 50 manhours per week.

positions.title: Graduate Research And Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
◦ Research Assistant - Distributed Password Cracker: Built a scalable distributed system capable of handling long running password cracking tasks sent by a web service and handled internally with Django and Celery in a lightweight Docker container.
◦ Teaching Assistant - Introductory C++: Responsible for grading and lecturing 100+ students a semester on the fundamentals of C++. Topics ranged from pointer arithmetic to object-oriented design principles.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
◦ Parole Officer Application: Built a cross-platform (Android, iOS) mobile application using Xamarin that assists 30,000+ parole officers in managing their caseload. Pulls in encrypted data from a thin REST API, stores data on phone’s local storage and distills information to the user when they are offline in a rural area.
◦ E2E Automated Testing: Used Selenium to design the framework for an automated testing suite to be used on the company’s web-based products. Later implemented into their continuous integration pipeline.

projects.title: Distributed System for Password Cracking using Probabilistic CFG’s
projects.description: Building distributed system in Docker environment for effective password cracking used by local law enforcement using Django, Celery, Redis and RabbitMQ

projects.title: Surveillance Footage Blurring
projects.description: Multiplexing project built with pthreads which detects and blurs personal information (faces, license plates) in surveillance footage using OpenCV
